output.summary: A genus of perennial herbs native to temperate parts of the Northern Hemisphere, especially North America and Europe, usually in wet or marshy places. Their small green or white flowers form umbrella-shaped clusters, but they resemble several edible plants. All parts are highly poisonous, with cicutoxin most concentrated in the roots, especially in early spring.
output.edibilityNote: All parts contain cicutoxin; roots are most toxic, especially in early spring, and ingestion can be fatal.
